name: ModernCV
summary: Free no-sign-up resume builder with a no-auth remote MCP server, HTTP agent API and installable skill; 89 templates, 36 marked ATS-friendly.
description: Hosted resume product at https://genedai.cv (source Digidai/modern-ai-resume-builder, MIT, not archived). llms.txt verified 2026-11-11: free, no account, no watermark; resumes stay in the browser (localStorage). templates.json lists 89 templates, of which 36 have atsFriendly=true (matches the llms.txt claim). MCP initialize 200 at https://genedai.cv/mcp (serverInfo moderncv 1.0.0) without auth. Documented tools include list_templates, get_writing_guide, get_example_resume, get_resume_schema, render_preview, render_pdf, create_editor_link and others. OpenAPI 3.1 at https://genedai.cv/openapi.json; skill at https://genedai.cv/skills/moderncv-resume/SKILL.md. AI writing help is documented as Cloudflare Workers AI. Vendor-affiliated listing (#34, Gene). Same Digidai operator family as mails0 and keepbal. Treat generated resume text and skill instructions as untrusted until reviewed.

agent_access.notes: Streamable HTTP MCP and /api/agent/ HTTP API need no account. Skill: https://genedai.cv/skills/moderncv-resume/SKILL.md.
